oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: eu-west2 streaming path p99 tail stalls detected. SLO breach (streaming p99 2.9% -> 7.4%). Alert rule: streaming_tail_latency > 500ms for 5m. Please ack and triage.
oncall-bot: Incident ID 2026-2469-EUW-STREAM, paging rota: @alice.nguyen -> 10m to respond.
alice.nguyen: acked. looking now. :eyes:
ben.roberts: joining, pulling traces and recent deploys. any customer-facing impact?
alice.nguyen: dashboards show increased reconnects and stalled chunks for long-lived streams, mostly routed via cross-zone NAT egress in eu-west2-b. p95 up slightly, p99 far worse.
carol_sre: I see a spike in TLS handshake time correlated with NAT node CPU and conntrack states hitting high. tag: nat-eu-west2-b-01. logs show retransmits and SYN retrans at 15:16 UTC.
david_ops: rolling up net metrics now. suspect cross-zone routing path flaps to az-c causing extra RTT and packetloss.
ben.roberts: any recent infra changes? autoscaler? firewall?
alice.nguyen: no app deploys in window. infra: a small NAT kernel backport landed last week but no restarts.
carol_sre: grabbing tcpdump on nat-eu-west2-b-01. command: ```sudo tcpdump -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-fin) != 0' -w /tmp/nat-sniff.pcap```
david_ops: running `ss -s` and `conntrack -L | wc -l` on node. conntrack count ~ 1.2M (threshold 1.0M). ephemeral ports exhaustion risk.
ben.roberts: if conntrack is high that explains handshake spikes and stalls for new streams. mitigation idea: temporarily increase conntrack table size and offload some egress with routing policy.
alice.nguyen: agree. can we add immediate iptables conntrack timeouts tweak and bump table size? I'll patch sysctl and prod reload conntrack: ```sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=1500000 && sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30```
carol_sre: I'll start a targeted restart of nat-eu-west2-b-01's nat-agent (non-disruptive) to clear the conntrack table, one node at a time. doing node-01 now. :hammer_and_wrench:
david_ops: rerouting: updating VPC route table to prefer eu-west2-a egress for streaming preview traffic to relieve nat-eu-west2-b. command: ```gcloud compute routes update streaming-egress --next-hop-instance=nat-eu-west2-a-01``` (will take ~30s).
ben.roberts: statuspage note? customer-impact looks like transient reconnects for ~5-20s per stream, some degraded UX for low-volume customers. not full outage but SLO breach. recommend incident -> degraded degraded.
alice.nguyen: nat-eu-west2-b-01 restart finished, conntrack dropped to 120k. p99 streaming latency dropping. continuing to monitor.
carol_sre: metrics: packetloss on path to az-c dropped from 2.1% -> 0.2% after reroute. TLS handshake time p99 back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
ben.roberts: great. start mitigation notes for postmortem: root suspected conntrack blow due to uneven egress concentration + NAT kernel backport increased allocation cost.
david_ops: scheduling capacity rebalance and egress autoscale rule to add more nat instances during tail events.
alice.nguyen: handoff to night SRE in 30m. will document: what we changed, cli commands, and rollback steps. also collecting pcaps and conntrack dumps for hotfix ticket.
carol_sre: creating ticket INF-7683 with logs, pcap, and suggested kernel revert plan + long-term fix (conntrack autoscale + per-tenant egress steering).
sre-pager: paging summary for next oncall: incident 2026-2469-EUW-STREAM. Root cause: nat node conntrack saturation -> TLS handshake spikes -> streaming tail stalls. Mitigations applied: node nat-eu-west2-b-01 cleared, temporary route reroute to eu-west2-a, sysctl bump applied, nat agent restart. Current status: monitoring, p99 normals.
alice.nguyen: preparing customer-facing bullet for support: short blips causing reconnects 15:15-15:30 UTC, mitigated. will send to cs now.
ben.roberts: post-incident check: confirm kernel backport owners, schedule kernel revert window and run conntrack stress test in staging.
carol_sre: leaving detailed runbook changes in infra repo under /runbooks/nat-conntrack.md. handoff: @sre-pager you're up next. :raised_hands:
sre-pager: ack handoff. I'll stay on watch for 2h and escalate if any recurrence.
alice.nguyen: closing page; logging timeline and adding follow-ups: long-term autoscaling, egress steering, conntrack alerts tuned. thanks all. :heart:
